issues.title: Defensibility needs empirical validation
issues.explanation: Investors will push hard on how long your ML model advantage lasts before competitors replicate telemetry tuning.
issues.suggestion: Highlight proprietary synthetic stress-test data and telemetry network effects across customer clusters.

issues.title: Pilot conversion timeline is vague
issues.explanation: You cite 8 active pilots but don't specify the contractual terms or letters of intent (LOI).
issues.suggestion: Add dollar-weighted pipeline: '8 pilots representing $240K qualified ARR with 3 signed LOIs'.

issues.title: Milestones for seed round should be explicit
issues.explanation: Seed investors want to see what exact metrics and validation unlock the Series A round.
issues.suggestion: Specify: '$2.0M funding will bring ARR to $1.2M and 50 enterprise clusters within 15 months'.

investor_objections: Why won't AWS or Google Cloud build this right into EKS and GKE to commoditize you?
How do you convince conservative CTOs to allow an external AI agent write access to production clusters?
Is 12% gain-share sustainable once baseline costs stabilize and easy waste is trimmed?
top_priorities: Address cluster security and safe-rollback isolation on Slide 3 (Product)
Add specific ARR and expansion milestone targets on Slide 12 (Ask)
Quantify pilot conversion metrics on Slide 10 (Traction)
